official_source: Embassy of France in South Africa (France Excellence Scholarship)
duration: Master's: duration of the degree (typically 2 years); PhD: up to 3 years

title: Pasteur-Paris University (PPU) International Doctoral Program 2027
description: The Institut Pasteur runs the Pasteur-Paris University (PPU) international doctoral programme with Université Paris Cité, Sorbonne Université and Université Paris Saclay for candidates holding a Master's degree or equivalent in life or medical sciences. Selected students are employees of the Institut Pasteur on a three-year working contract and receive a monthly salary of EUR 2,000 inclusive of social benefits, a EUR 4,000 welcome bonus, annual round-trip travel reimbursement and EUR 750 per year for conferences or summer courses. title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po (Graduate Level)
duration: Two years of Master's study in person in Paris
description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po is the first such programme in continental Europe and supports students from the African continent who wish to pursue a two-year Master's degree at Sciences Po, covering the full financial needs of selected Scholars. title: Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship
description: The Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship is a merit-based stipend awarded by Semmelweis University to international students who have an outstanding record after at least two completed semesters. The amount depends on the faculty, with the highest amounts for the Faculty of Medicine and Dentistry and for the Andras Peto Faculty and the lowest for Health Sciences, and it is paid in 12 equal monthly instalments.
